latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of aws-global-search.

- Query AWS product information, documentation, parameters, features, and pricing from official sources without login.
- Supports both English and Chinese user queries for AWS services.
- Provides full AWS product catalog with product names, categories, and descriptions.
- Assists users in identifying AWS products based on keywords, aliases, and functional/business requirements.
- Enables easy comparison and lookup of specifications, pricing, and documentation for AWS products.
